name: sc-pwsh
description: PowerShell stack skills that detect the target host (Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7), audit scripts, find host-specific legacy, and teach the divergences.

interface.longDescription: Detect the PowerShell host a script targets, audit scripts against measured idioms, find constructs that break on one host, and explain the 5.1 versus 7 divergences.
defaultPrompt: Detect the PowerShell host these scripts target
Which constructs break on Windows PowerShell 5.1?
